    SELECT f."School Type",
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS "School Name",
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS classification,
           s.Latitude
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
),
middle_schools AS (
    SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
    FROM school_records
    WHERE classification IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR LOWER(' ' || "School Name" || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z]middle[^a-z]*'
       OR LOWER(' ' || "School Name" || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z]intermediate[^a-z]*'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%Junior High%'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%Jr. High%'
       OR "School Name" LIKE '%Jr High%'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Charter, s.GSserved,
           f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (s.GSserved = '12' OR s.GSserved LIKE '%-12')
), winners AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    WHERE meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(meal_rate) FROM eligible)
)
SELECT w.School AS school_name,
       ROUND(w.meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE w.Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       w.GSserved AS grades_served,
       CASE
           WHEN t.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR t.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR t.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
           WHEN t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
           WHEN t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM winners AS w
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = w.CDSCode
ORDER BY w.School, w.CDSCode;
```

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l
        ON l.CreationDate >= m.month_start
       AND l.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
    LEFT JOIN posts AS p
        ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
       AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM monthly_counts;
```

WITH readings AS (
    SELECT ID, LDH, TRIM("U-PRO") AS protein
    FROM Laboratory
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT ID, LDH,
           CASE
               WHEN protein LIKE '>=%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(protein, 3))
               WHEN protein GLOB '+[0-9](*)' THEN
                   SUBSTR(protein, 4, LENGTH(protein) - 4)
               ELSE protein
           END AS concentration
    FROM readings
),
qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING MAX(LDH) >= 500
       AND MAX(CASE
                   WHEN concentration NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
                    AND concentration NOT LIKE '%.%.%'
                   THEN CAST(concentration AS REAL)
               END) >= 100
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;
```
